steps.title: Load the quarter's lobbying filings
steps.prose: Invented sample data — what each client paid to ask government for, as filed.
steps.data_description: Every filing in the sample, as the CSV records it.

steps.title: Load each client's public commitment
steps.prose: What each client told everyone else it would do, one promise each — a repeat fails the run rather than quietly multiplying filings.
steps.data_description: Every organisation with a public commitment on record.

steps.title: Clean every filing's reported spend before anything reads it
steps.prose: The spend is text on the filing until someone reads it as a number, and one that could not be read stopped the run rather than travelling as a blank.
steps.data_description: Every filing in the sample, with its reported spend read as a number.

steps.title: Put each promise beside the ask
steps.prose: Nothing is dropped: a blank promise means the client has none on record, and the absence IS the record.
steps.data_description: Every filing, plus its client's commitment where one matched.

steps.title: Judge the ask against the promise
steps.prose: A model proposes how the two stand and writes one sentence saying why. Trust this step least — read both texts yourself.
steps.data_description: The same filings, plus the model's judgment and its one sentence.

steps.title: Put every contradiction in front of a person
steps.prose: The model's label is only a proposal: every contradiction it flagged waits here for a person to keep or change, under their own name.
steps.data_description: Every filing, plus the label a person left on the ones the model called contradictions.

steps.title: Publish the report
steps.prose: What you hand to someone who was not here — open it under Published. Each row is linked back to the filing it came from, and each printed contradiction names whoever reviewed it.
steps.data_description: One row per filing, as published.
